nonBlockingIssues.description: `test_rhesus_and_macaque_produce_identical_output()` compares only a few metadata columns, so numbering drift could slip through without failing the test.
`test_macaque_renumbering_unchanged_regression()` only checks Kabat position 30 if the column already exists, so the regression guard is weaker than intended.

appliedUpdates.description: Corrected `.factory/library/architecture.md` to reflect the live HMM fallback order (custom -> LocalHMMBuilder -> G3 -> Legacy ANARCI) and documented the `rhesus` -> `macaque` alias before local/custom HMM lookup.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remove pytest examples that pipe output through `tail` or similar filters; they can mask failures and conflict with validator guidance.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `rename-germline-keys-rhesus-to-macaque` cited `.factory/skills/python-library-worker/SKILL.md` examples using `| tail`, and the feature handoff reported the same mismatch with mission guidance.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Allow repo-specific `AGENTS.md` validation guidance to replace unconditional full-suite pytest requirements when the mission documents known exclusions or impractical runtime constraints.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The review for `update-hmm-routing-and-backward-compat` found the skill still requires `poetry run pytest` even though this mission's `AGENTS.md` explicitly allows scoped alternatives; the feature worker timed out on the full suite before falling back to targeted tests.
